_meta.openai/widgetDescription: This card already shows the user the full document: parties, dates, every line, VAT, totals and status. Reply in one or two sentences. Do not repeat or redraw the document, its lines or its totals, as text or as a table. Still mention any warning or note in the result.

description: Use this when the user asks about one sales invoice by number or id: its lines, total, VAT, balance or status ("show me INV-0042"). One invoice by invoice_id or invoice_number: client name and TRN, lines, subtotal, VAT, total, amounts paid and credited, balance (remaining), status, due date, and app_url, a link that opens it in Fatura Go for the signed-in user. For a draft, issue_check lists what it is missing as a tax invoice (as check_invoice_before_issue). No client contact details. Do not use it to list several invoices (list_invoices) or to change one (update_draft_invoice).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out: the invoice is then looked up in every business shared with this connection.
